scenes.title: NABH 6th Edition — Implementation & Compliance
scenes.narration: Welcome to the short-term course on National Accreditation Board for Hospitals and Healthcare Providers, sixth edition: implementation and compliance. It prepares whole hospital teams to meet the current accreditation standard, so that compliance is continuous rather than assessment driven.

notes.note: Prepares whole hospital teams to meet the current accreditation standard
Compliance that is continuous, not assessment driven

scenes.narration: You will learn to explain the structure and chapters of the standard, interpret each objective element and the evidence it requires, plan departmental documentation and records for readiness, and apply internal audit methods to close compliance gaps.
scenes.mermaid:

  A[Explain structure, chapters] --> B[Interpret objective elements] --> C[Plan documentation, records] --> D[Apply internal audit]:::teal

scenes.kicker: What you will be able to do
scenes.narration: Over 16 hours of learning, you will be able to map your department's daily work to objective elements, assemble evidence files that withstand assessor scrutiny, conduct an internal audit and record non-conformities correctly, and draft policies and standard operating procedures.

It is for quality managers and coordinators, administrators, department heads, nursing superintendents, medical officers and support service in-charges. Enroll in the short-term course on National Accreditation Board for Hospitals and Healthcare Providers, sixth edition: implementation and compliance now.
